song.title: O happy day that fixed my choice
song.lyrics:
[V1] .F O happy day that fixed my choice . C F On Thee, my Savior and my God! .F Well may this glowing heart rejoice, . C F And tell its raptures all abroad.
[C1] . F Happy day, happy day, . C F When Jesus washed my sins away! . F He taught me how to watch and pray, . F And live rejoicing every day; . F Happy day, happy day, . C F When Jesus washed my sins away!
[V2] .F 'Tis done-the great transaction's done; . C F I am my Lord's, and He is mine; .F He drew me and I followed on, . C F Rejoiced to own the call divine.
[V3] .F Now rest, my long-divided heart, . C F Fixed on this blissful center, rest; .F Here have I found a nobler part, . C F Here heav'nly pleasures fill my breast.
[V4] .F High heav'n that hears the solemn vow, .F C F That vow renewed shall daily hear! .F Till in life's latest hour I bow, . C F And bless, in death, a bond so dear.
